ACIDOSIS 
* pH < 7.2 
Refractory to HCO3 
Symptomatic arrhythmias 
ELECTROLYTES 
*Intractable hyperkalaemia 
 
INGESTION 
*Salicylates 
*Barbiturates 
*Lithium 
*Toxic alcohols i.e. methanol, ethanol, 
ethylene glycol (often) 
*Theophylline/Caffeine 
*INH (Seldom) 
*Metformin 
*Dabigatran 
*Sodium valproate 
*Carbamazepine 
OVERLOAD 
*Acute pulmonary oedema 
URAEMIC COMPLICATIONS 
*Confusion (encephalopathy) 
*Pericarditis 
*Seizures 
*Platelet dysfunction causing bleeding 
*Gastritis/UGIB 
Contents 
INDICATIONS FOR DIALYSIS 
“AEIOU”
